releaseNotes:
• Agent Chat Layout Bounds: Fixed subheader vertical expansion by enforcing tight height bounds (38dp) and responsive single-line truncation on model chips, provider text, and token counters
• Model Selection Pill Hardening: Prevented character-by-character vertical text squishing on FREE/PAID status pills when displaying long model names
• GlassBadge Wrap Prevention: Hardened glass pill badges app-wide with single-line and ellipsis constraints
• Layout Stability: Guaranteed smooth chat messaging viewport with zero header void ballooning
